title: opentofu/apply Action output
description: Typed output values of a completed opentofu/apply (§2.2: an Action declares an output Contract), captured on the Run for cross-Step binding ({{.steps.<name>.outputs.<field>}}). The TOP level is closed; `outputs` is deliberately open because its keys are the module's own and a Contract that enumerated them would be a different Contract per module — which is exactly the per-provider typing §1.1 refuses. The module's shape is still typed, by the rung-2 schema the Apply verb derives from `tofu output -json` (ADR-0017/§2.2).

workspace.description: The state workspace it was applied to.

outputs.description: The module's own outputs, verbatim, MINUS the reserved stratt_entities (which is the governed projection channel, not a value) and with every output tofu marked `sensitive` replaced by "(sensitive)" — a Run's captured outputs are not a secret channel (§2.5), and a content-blind core cannot do that redaction for us.
